basic_info.description:
On the market for the first time in nearly eight decades, 1775 37th Ave is a true Outer Sunset gem. This classic 1940s home was custom-built by the original developer and purchased directly by the current family, who have lovingly cared for it for 79 years, making them the last original owners on the block. 

The upper level features 2 bedrooms and 1 bath, with beautiful original hardwood floors that have never been used and remain in pristine condition beneath the carpet. Built in 1947 and thoughtfully expanded in the early 1950s to include the bedroom and bathroom on the lower level, the home offers timeless San Francisco charm throughout. 

From the rear bedrooms, wake up to soft ocean light and end your days with breathtaking sunsets and expansive peek-a-boo ocean views. 

The private backyard offers a peaceful retreat ready for someone to transform into a lush garden or outdoor entertaining space. 

Just minutes from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, Noriega Street cafes/shops, great schools, and public transportation, this home captures the essence of coastal San Francisco living. Come and own a piece of the sunset on 37th Ave.
